MainText: Debris avalanches and debris flows warning yellow level for Vestland and northern parts of Rogaland
WarningText: Rain is expected Thursday morning, up to 60-80 mm/12h. Follow the weather radar. Steep slopes, as well as streams and rivers with high discharge, are particularly exposed. Debris flows may reach the valley bottom even if they are triggered high in the terrain.
AdviceText: Keep away from steep slopes, as well as streams and rivers with high discharge. Keep yourself updated about the development of the weather, the landslide and flood situation, and follow the weather radar. Keep water paths and culverts free of snow, ice, gravel, waste, twigs and leaves. Clogged waterways with dammed water may cause landslides.
ConsequenceText: Landslides may be expected. Exposed railways and roads may be closed.
Area: Vestland and northern parts of Rogaland
